description: Draft a plain-language shared-living agreement (parties, term, equal rent shares, deposit, utilities, house rules, notice, signature lines) plus a pre-signing checklist. Use when housemates want house terms in writing. Not legal advice. Do NOT use to compute unequal rent (use split_rent) or bill shares (use split_utilities).

deposit.description: Total deposit amount, 0 or more (0 = no deposit)

house_rules.description: Custom house rules, one sentence each; default covers quiet hours, guests, cleaning rota and shared supplies

monthly_rent.description: Total monthly rent for the home, positive; split equally between tenants in the text

notice_period_months.description: Notice period in whole months, default 1

property_address.description: Street address of the shared home, e.g. '12 Elm Street, Flat 3'

room_assignments.description: Optional: who sleeps in which room, one room per tenant; names must match tenants

tenants.description: Unique names of all tenants (at least 2), e.g. ["Asha","Dev"]

utilities_policy.description: One sentence on how utilities are shared; default: split equally between tenants unless agreed otherwise

name: roommate_agreement

agreement.description: Full agreement text, numbered sections and signature lines

checklist.description: Practical steps to complete before signing

title: Roommate agreement
